modern: Let this always be clear to you, that this piece of land is like any other; and that all things here are the same as things on the top of a mountain, or on the seashore, or wherever you choose to be. For you will find just what Plato says: Living within the walls of a city as in a shepherd’s fold on a mountain.

explained.summary: This place is no different from any other. Life on a mountaintop, by the sea or anywhere else is the same, because what matters is how you live, not where. Marcus recalls Plato’s image of living inside the city walls as if in a shepherd’s fold on a mountain: the solitude you want can come with you.
explained.today: The dream of escaping to a cottage by the sea or a cabin in the hills often assumes a new place will make you a new person. The calm you’re after is just as available on the bus or at your desk.
